• Origin: cultivar
  • Growth rate: slow
  • Height: 3 - 10+ cm
  • Light demand: low
  • CO2: low

Anubias 'Mini Coin' is as easy to grow as its parent, and so does not like bright light. It thrives best attached to rocks and tree roots in the aquarium. If planted in the substrate, the creeping stem (rhizome) must not be covered as this can cause the plant to rot and die.

It branches readily and will form a dense cushion of small, round, deep green leaves. If the plant becomes too dense, it can be carefully divided and the new plants placed elsewhere in the aquarium.

Anubias 'Mini Coin' is a variety of Anubias barteri found at the aquarium nursery Tropica in Denmark. The plant is among the very smallest Anubias, each leaf smaller than a little fingernail. It is ideal for use in nano aquariums, but can also add to the small details of a larger aquarium.
